name: Telegram Bot — SR Gentle Companion (Mandala Symbiosis)
description: Autonomous SR Companion bot. OpenRouter LLM with sliding window memory, Mer-Ka-Ba profile, multi-user, voice, reminders, web search, Ahimsa filter, idea seeds. v7.1.1 deployed with scheduler protection and HTML parse fix.
done: v6.0.2: In-memory store, health check, concurrent GitHub sync
v6.1.0: Free dialogue fallback, intent detection, quick action buttons
v7.0.0: SR system prompt with Mandala philosophy (Ahimsa, Mer-Ka-Ba, Flower of Life)
v7.0.0: Idea filter + save to seeds/ replacing engineer chat button
v7.0.1: Fixed model IDs for OpenRouter
v7.0.2: Multi-model fallback chain (5 free models)
v7.1.0: Sliding window chat history per user (_sessions dict, last 40 messages)
v7.1.0: Model upgrade: qwen/qwen3.5-flash primary (1M ctx), mistral-small-3 fallback
v7.1.1: Fixed HTML parse error in free_conversation, wrapped scheduler jobs in try/except

v7.2.0: Persistent chat memory: store _sessions in memory.json per user, sync to GitHub
SHA-based refresh: check file SHA before full download (reduces API requests 3-4x)
Periodic workspace refresh: check SHA every 5 min, reload only if changed
Multi-user readiness: dynamic gardener_{telegram_id} folder creation
Achievements as metrics: counter in profile.json instead of separate file
Response formatting: line breaks for readability, short answers for simple questions, expand only when meaningful
Typing indicator: send chat_action 'typing' before LLM response

blocks_next.B: Multi-user: dynamic gardener_{telegram_id}, own folder per user, _store multi-user
blocks_next.C: Mer-Ka-Ba profile: Body/Spirit/World spheres in onboarding and profile
blocks_next.D: UX: grouped menu, changelog announcements, multilingual support
blocks_next.E: Intelligence: reminders system, Tavily search in bot, progressive gardener learning

architecture.llm: OpenRouter — qwen3.5-flash (1M ctx) with 5-model fallback chain
architecture.memory: _sessions = {user_id: [messages]} — sliding window 40 msg, to be persisted in memory.json
architecture.store: In-memory _store + fire-and-forget GitHub sync every 2 min
architecture.context_budget: system_prompt(~500) + history(~5K) + gardener_profile(~1K) + current_msg = ~8K per request

file_structure.description: Achievements become counter in profile.json. Tasks + groups merged into workspace.json. Chat history persisted in memory.json.
file_structure.archive: workspace_YYYY-MM.json for completed tasks, memory_YYYY-QX.json for old chat history

model_selection.primary: qwen/qwen3.5-flash — 1M context, $0.065 in/$0.26 out, best for long sessions

acceptance_criteria: Bot remembers conversation context within session (sliding window)
Model chain auto-switches on rate limit without user seeing error
Free dialogue feels natural and warm, follows Ahimsa
Each user has own gardener folder
Ahimsa filter rejects destructive topics gracefully
Context never exceeds model limit — old messages trimmed automatically
Chat history persists across bot restarts (memory.json)
Achievements stored as counter in profile.json
Responses use line breaks, short for simple questions, expand only when meaningful
Typing indicator shown before LLM response

health.notes: v7.1.1 deployed and stable. v7.2.0 planning: persistent memory, SHA optimization, 3-file structure, achievements as metrics, response formatting, typing indicator.
